CR-APT-001.message: unpublished_story_draft: Please confirm whether the 07:18 Alder Point Central incident involved only equipment smoke or any hazardous-material release, whether any injuries are officially confirmed, and whether the station evacuation and service suspension timeline in your circulated statement remains accurate as of this request.

CR-005A.message: unpublished_story_draft: We are verifying a viral allegation that Harborlight Mutual Aid in Linton diverted winter-relief donations to non-restricted uses. Please respond by 2026-01-14 16:00 with any clarification about donation restrictions, emergency accounting, and whether any internal review found misuse. We are specifically asking about the allegation, not about unrelated city reimbursement filings or prior archived bookkeeping issues.

DR-005-INTERNAL.content: unpublished_story_draft: Internal memo should state that the viral allegation is currently unproven, that bounded source review found a named tipster with firsthand volunteer exposure but incomplete financial support, that municipal materials do not confirm misuse, that public filings do not independently establish donor-fund diversion, and that the story remains on hold pending a single request for comment to the shelter spokesperson.

DR-005-PUBLIC.content: unpublished_story_draft: Draft public correction copy should say that available records do not currently substantiate the online claim that Harborlight Mutual Aid in Linton diverted winter-relief donations, that some cited materials relate to routine reimbursement or outdated bookkeeping issues, and that additional response was requested from the shelter before any publication decision.

PD-APT-001.content: unpublished_story_draft: Current verification indicates an evacuation and service disruption at Alder Point Central tied to smoke from equipment, while available dispatch, agency, and record materials do not substantiate a toxic leak or multiple confirmed casualties. Protected caller material is too tentative for publication without independent confirmation.

PD-APT-002.content: unpublished_story_draft: We can safely report that Alder Point Transit temporarily evacuated Alder Point Central after a smoke-related equipment incident and that service was disrupted. We should avoid repeating viral claims of a toxic leak or multiple fatalities because public records reviewed so far do not confirm them.
